name: my-arena-bot
description: A Screeps: Arena bot written in C++

scripts.build: arena-with-emsdk cmake --preset wasm && arena-with-emsdk cmake --build --preset wasm
scripts.build:debug: arena-with-emsdk cmake --preset wasm-debug && arena-with-emsdk cmake --build --preset wasm-debug
scripts.test: npm run test:cpp && npm run test:sim
scripts.test:cpp: cmake --preset native && cmake --build --preset native && ctest --preset native
scripts.deploy: npm run bundle && cp dist/main.mjs "${ARENA_DIR:?set ARENA_DIR to your arena source folder}/main.mjs"
